title: HR Case Notes — Confidential
body: CONFIDENTIAL — HR only. Case HR-0142: a workplace-conduct complaint was received and reviewed per Sample Corp's standard investigation process. The investigation concluded on 2026-05-28 with a coaching plan issued; no further disciplinary action was required. This document exists purely as a permissions-model fixture for the cookbook's permissions-aware-rag recipe — it demonstrates that a document restricted to the Sample-HR group is invisible to a general employee query, exactly the property the recipe's demo verifies.
